File Number: 22928-T1

17-13-0303-C(1) SUBSTITUTE Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 2531-2533 W. Augusta Blvd..
Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-S5 Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 6,534.8 sq. ft.
2531 W. Augusta Blvd. - 3,417.05 square feet
2533 W. Augusta Blvd. — 3,117.75 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant intends to divide the single zoning lot into two (2) separate
zoning lots so that the newly created lot at 2531 W. Augusta Blvd. can be
developed with a new four-story, three (3) unit residential building. The
proposed building will be masonry construction and measure 45 ft. in
height. Three (3) garage parking spaces will be located at the rear of that
lot. The height and footprint of the existing two-story six (6) unit residential
building at 2533 W. Augusta Blvd. will remain without change. The
detached garage and coach houseat the rear will be taken down and replaced
with three (3) off-street surface parking spaces. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location, Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-
1003-EE and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance. the
Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking requirement for a
Transit Served Location from 50% (2 parking spaces) to 100% (3 parking
spaces) and reduce the front setback to 10 ft. for the proposed building at
2531 W. Augusta Blvd., and for the existing building at 2531 W. Augusta
Blvd., reduce the off-street parking requirement to three (3) parking spaces,
reduce the front setback to 10.87 ft, reduce the combined side setback total
to 2.86 ft. (west side setback at 0.38 ft.; east side setback at 2.48 ft.), reduce
the rear yard open space to 108 sq. ft., and is seeking all relief necessary, as
allowed by the code, to permit the zoning lot division and new construction
building per the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. 2531 W. Augusta Blvd.: 5,950 square feet (1.74 FAR)
b, 2533 W. Augusta Blvd.: 3,204 square feet (1.03 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
a. 2531 W. Augusta Blvd.: 1,139.02 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)
b. 2533 W. Augusta Blvd.: 519.625 square feet per D.U.
{6 residential units)

(C) — *The amount of off-street parking:
a. 2531 W. Augusta Blvd.: 3 parking spaces
b. 2533 W. Augusta Blvd.: 3 parking spaces

Final for Publication

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Western Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
off-street parking requirement from 50% (two (2) parking spaces) to 100% (three
(3) parking spaces) at 2531 W. Augusta Blvd., and reduce the off-street parkirig
requirement at 2533 W. Augusta Blvd. to 50% (three (3) parking spaces).

(D) — Setbacks:
a, *2531 West Augusta Boulevard:
i. Front Setback: — 10 feet (proposed)
ii. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 3 feet (proposed)
East Side: 3 feet (proposed)
iii. Rear Setback: 37.4 feet (proposed)

*The Applicant is seeking to reduce the front setback at 2531 W. Augusta Blvd. to
10 ft.

b. *2533 West Augusta Boulevard:
i, Front Setback: 10.87 feet (existing to remain)
ii. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 0.38 feet (existing to remain)
East Side: 2.48 feet (proposed)
iii. Rear Setback: 43.8 (existing to remain)

*The Applicant is seeking to reduce the front setback at 2533 W. Augusta Blvd. to
10.87 ft., reduce the total combined side setback to 2.86 ft., with the west side
setback to be 0.38 ft. and the east side setback to be 2.48 ft.

(E) Building Height:
a. 2531 West Augusta Boulevard: 45 feet (proposed)
b, 2533 West Augusta Boulevard: 27 feet (existing to remain)
